title: Inflammatory myofibroblastic tumor in a 9-year-old male neutered mixed-breed dog with gastrointestinal signs; a case report.
abstract: A 9-year-old male neutered mixed-breed dog was presented with chronic diarrhea and vomiting. Abdominal ultrasonography revealed a mass in the jejunum, which was surgically excised. Histopathological examination and immunohistochemistry confirmed the diagnosis of an inflammatory myofibroblastic tumor (IMT). This case report discusses the clinical presentation, diagnostic approach, and management of IMT in this dog.
